theory.title: Exercise 4.3.1: Get Current Date
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Time is critical in automation. When did this test run? How old is this log entry? Get Current Date gives you the current time in any format you need."

Get Current Date

Get current timestamp:

Library    DateTime

${now}=    Get Current Date
# Default: 2025-10-04 14:30:15.123456

${formatted}=    Get Current Date    result_format=%Y-%m-%d
# Result: 2025-10-04

${time}=    Get Current Date    result_format=%H:%M:%S
# Result: 14:30:15

Format Codes:

  • %Y: 4-digit year (2025)
  • %m: Month (01-12)
  • %d: Day (01-31)
  • %H: Hour 24h (00-23)
  • %M: Minute (00-59)
  • %S: Second (00-59)
  • epoch: Unix timestamp

Example: Test Execution Log

*** Settings ***
Library    DateTime

*** Test Cases ***
Timestamped Test
    ${start}=    Get Current Date    result_format=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S
    Log    Test started: ${start}
    # ... test logic ...
    ${end}=    Get Current Date    result_format=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S
    Log    Test ended: ${end}

⚠️ Get Current Date Tips

  • Default format includes microseconds
  • Use result_format for custom output
  • epoch format returns seconds since 1970-01-01
  • UTC option: Get Current Date time_zone=UTC
  • Increment time: Get Current Date increment=1 hour
